access.title: You cannot see declarations here
access.body: Declarations & instructions needs the right to read the certificate register (compliance.certificates.view). An administrator gives it in Admin › Users, with a role such as Quality inspector.

offline.title: Offline: changes wait
offline.body: You see the last copy read. New drafts, translations, checks and withdrawals need the network: their buttons say so until it is back.

coverage.title: Language coverage
coverage.note: Each PPE style's current revision: DoC and user information against the languages the markets you sell in need (Rules & markets).
coverage.failed: The language coverage could not be read
coverage.legend: Issued r3 = signed and in force for revision 3 · Draft = generated or waiting for its PDF · In translation = words still to type · Checked = translation checked, still a draft · Missing = a market needs it · Not needed = no market asks for it.
coverage.emptyTitle: No style sells in a market yet
coverage.empty: The coverage lists the PPE styles in production against the languages of the markets switched on in Rules & markets.
coverage.noneFilteredHint: Every language is covered for these filters.

grid.title: Declarations
grid.failed: The declarations could not be read
grid.moreHeld: The first 500 are shown: narrow the filters to see the rest.
grid.empty: W1 keeps the signed DoC as a file on the style (Products › Styles › Compliance); here you generate drafts from the records and see every language.

law.doc: The manufacturer draws up the EU declaration of conformity with the content of Annex IX, keeps it up to date and translates it into the languages the market's state requires.
law.userInformation: Each PPE goes with the manufacturer's instructions and information (Annex II 1.4), in a language the users of that market understand.
law.docWithGoods: The PPE goes with its instructions and the EU declaration of conformity, or the address where it can be read.

gate.title: Generated declarations and leaflets are drafts until checked
gate.body: A PPE consultant checks each generated template once (GATE-PPE-TEXTS). Until then nothing generated here is issued: the signed PDF uploaded on the style stays the declaration in force and goes with the goods.
gate.signedRoute: Upload the signed PDF on the style (Products › Styles › Compliance)
gate.signedRouteWhere: The signed PDF is uploaded on each style: Products › Styles › Compliance.

code.NOT_PPE: The style is not PPE: it needs no declaration.
code.NO_REVISION: The style has no revision to declare.
code.NO_MAKER: No manufacturer's name and address: set the economic operator (Rules & markets) or the company's address.
code.NO_CERTIFICATE: No valid EU type-examination certificate covers this style (category II and III need one).
code.PHRASE_MISSING: A fixed sentence is missing in this language: add it to the phrase library (Rules & markets › Phrases).
code.STANDARD_NOT_IN_REGISTER: A standard is not in the register of laws and standards: its Official Journal date is not printed.
code.STANDARD_NOT_IN_FORCE: A standard is no longer in force in the register: check the certificate.
code.LEGISLATION_NOT_IN_REGISTER: Regulation (EU) 2016/425 is not in the register: its citation is printed as written.
code.POINT8_TO_TYPE: Category III: type the production-phase module (C2 or D) and its notified body in point 8.
code.SIGNATORY_TO_TYPE: Type who signs, with function, place and date.
code.PHRASE_PLACEHOLDERS: A translated sentence lost one of its values: the built-in words are used.
code.PHRASE_BUILT_IN: A sentence comes from the generator's built-in words, not from the phrase library.
code.NO_CLASS: EN 17092 without a class: the class is not printed.
code.NO_PROTECTORS: No protector placement although the class needs them.
code.SPARE_NOT_CERTIFIED: A spare protector has no valid certificate at the level needed: it is not listed.
code.CLASS_WARNING_MISSING: The class warning is missing in this language (phrase library).
code.POSITION_NOTE_AS_TYPED: A placement note prints as typed (its language is not known).
code.NO_BODY_ADDRESS: The notified body's address is not in the register: it is not printed.
code.PLACEMENT: A protector placement needs a look (Products › Styles › Sizes).

new.title: New declaration
new.draftNote: What you make here is a draft until a PPE consultant checks its template (GATE-PPE-TEXTS). The signed PDF stays the live route.
new.noStyles: No PPE style in production yet.
new.styleHint: PPE styles; the draft is made for the style's current revision.
new.originalHint: The original is composed in this language; translations follow it.
new.translationsHint: From the phrase library first; what it lacks stays to type by a translator, then a second person checks.
new.marketHint: Its economic operators (the importer line). Leave empty for every market.
new.packsHint: Each market's user-information languages start as translations with it.
new.companyHint: The style is every company's: the declaration names the company that makes it.
new.previewWaits: Choose the style and the original's language: the preview shows what each point will hold and where it comes from.
new.previewFailed: The preview could not be read
new.missingPhrases_one: {count} sentence is missing from the phrase library in this language.
new.missingPhrases_other: {count} sentences are missing from the phrase library in this language.

translate.title: Translate {label}
translate.body: Each language is composed from the phrase library first. Words the library does not have keep the original's and wait for a translator, who types them here.
translate.check: A second person — never the one who started it or typed its words — checks each translation. It stays a draft until GATE-PPE-TEXTS.

check.title: Language check
check.body: Per style and kind: the languages the markets you sell in need (Rules & markets) against what is issued, gaps first.

unrecorded.title: Batches shipped without a recorded version
unrecorded.body: Shipments that left with PPE whose DoC and leaflet version is not recorded for the batch (PRD-295). Recording takes the signed documents the shipment chose and keeps the record for 10 years.
unrecorded.failed: The list could not be read
unrecorded.none: Every PPE batch that left has its DoC and user information version on record.

refusal.NO_REVISION: The style has no revision to declare.
refusal.NO_CERTIFICATE: No valid certificate covers this style.
refusal.PHRASE_MISSING: A fixed sentence is missing in this language (phrase library).
refusal.EXISTS: A generated draft of this revision and language exists already.
refusal.WITHDRAWN: A generated draft of this revision and language was withdrawn: the next revision gets its own.
refusal.TAKEN: A document in this language exists already: open it.
refusal.NOTHING_TO_ADD: Every language asked is there already.
refusal.DECLARATION: This is a DoC, not user information.
refusal.USER_INFORMATION: This is user information: its builder handles it.
refusal.SIGNED: This is a signed document: it is not changed here.
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: It is no longer a draft.
refusal.CHECKED: This translation is checked: send it back to the translator first.
refusal.WORDS_MISSING: Words still hold the original's or wait to be typed: type them first.
refusal.OWN_TRANSLATION: You started this translation: a second person checks it.
refusal.OWN_WORDS: You typed words of this translation: a second person checks it.
refusal.TRANSLATION: Translations are added to the original.
refusal.TRANSLATION_SIGNATORY: The signatory belongs to the original: point 9 follows it.
refusal.SAME_STATE: It is in that state already.
refusal.DOCUMENT_MISSING: A signed DoC or leaflet the shipment needs is missing.
refusal.DATABASE: The database refused it: something changed meanwhile. Read again and retry.
refusal.LANGUAGE: That is not a language code.
refusal.OTHER: Refused by the records: read again and retry.

problem.unavailable: The factory could not answer. Try again.
problem.company: The company chosen is not one you reach.
problem.invalid: Something entered was not accepted. Check the fields.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You may not see or do this.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed, or it belongs to another company.
problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile. Read it again, then retry.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.noAnswer: No answer: check the network and try again.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problem.read: It could not be read as it is.

publication.none: No public address for this style.

issue.freeze: When the signed PDF of revision {revision} is uploaded, batches already shipped keep their recorded version; new batches carry revision {revision}.
issue.signedBody: The signed PDF on the style is the declaration in force. A new version is uploaded there.
